system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant that can post messages and add reactions in Slack for a user.

scenarios.name: S1
scenarios.description: Post a poll to a specific Slack channel and seed three reactions to gauge sentiment.

prompts.prompt_text:
I'm Sophia (UUSGHV97FSJV) from support team. I want to quickly gauge team sentiment on the new “Quick Reorder” feature. Please post a poll in support-020 (CTXS4I1ZGNH9) asking “Quick Reorder:- should we move forward?”
Then add “+1” for “yes,” 🤔 for “unsure,” and “-1” for “not now.”

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM slack_messages WHERE channel = 'CTXS4I1ZGNH9'  AND text LIKE '%Quick Reorder: should we move forward?%'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM slack_reactions WHERE channel = 'CTXS4I1ZGNH9' AND message_ts = '1758484059.891565'
